Same code as your other Pathfinder tools — enter it once anywhere and it applies everywhere on this device. Whoever knows the code can read/write this data.
Pathfinder 1e Hunter spell list (Advanced Class Guide) — the combined Druid + Ranger lists, each spell at the LOWER of its two levels, capped at 6th — reusable for any hunter, save each one under their own name. Hunters are spontaneous casters like sorcerers: they know a fixed number of spells (the "Known" toggle), then cast any known spell of a level using that level's daily slot pool. Orisons (0-level) are known the same way but cast at will, unlimited. Uses Wisdom for bonus spells and DCs; caster level equals hunter level. Pairs with the Companion & Mount Hit&Damage Calculator for the hunter's own animal companion's attacks.
